title: Save the Myconids
summary: Some of the myconid people have given their life to Zyvan and Zeldris. This is so that they can defeat the mercenaries from hurting their people in the underdark.

title: Mytical Helmet Retrieval
objective: Retrieve a mythical helmet held by King Bruenor of Jarnulfrhöfuð.
summary: Gerbo asked Zyvan to retrieve a mythical helmet from Jarnulfrhöfuð. This helmet is held by King Bruenor, and it is known that he keeps it held in a safe place.
rewards: A gold amount known to Zyvan
notes: This guy who offered the quest was very rude to Zyvan >:(

title: Reclaim Reputation
objective: Prove to King Lucius that you are not evil.
summary: The council of the Elder Tree has seen propaganda that the Shadow Merchant Money Gang are ruthless evil tryants of the Elandria. King Lucius trusts the gang and is willing to give you a chance to prove your innocence.
rewards: Reputation of the Shadow Merchant Money Gang restored
